# Podcast MCP developer docs

- Docs: https://docs.sharecut.studio/
- Capabilities catalog: https://docs.sharecut.studio/#/capabilities
- Capabilities schema: https://docs.sharecut.studio/schemas/capabilities.manifest.schema.json
- Document-command schema: https://docs.sharecut.studio/schemas/document-commands.schema.json
- Guest OpenAPI: https://docs.sharecut.studio/schemas/guest-share.openapi.json
- UX pack: https://ux.sharecut.studio/
- Repo: https://github.com/calebn/sharecut-studio

Public API status: alpha (may break without notice).

## For agents

1. Read https://docs.sharecut.studio/#/quickstart
2. Use share token URLs only — never invent host filesystem paths
3. Prefer guest_submit_document_command / document-command schema for mutations
4. Respect caps from the share; call MCP tools/list for the allowed tool set
5. Host surface matrix (GUI / keys / MCP / skills): https://docs.sharecut.studio/#/capabilities
